title: Senior Network Security Engineer
description:
The Network Security Engineer is responsible for protecting an organization’s networks and data from cyber threats. This role involves designing, implementing, and maintaining security infrastructure (firewalls, intrusion detection/prevention systems, VPNs, etc.) and monitoring the network for vulnerabilities or incidents. The engineer will play a critical role in upholding Zero Trust security principles and ensuring high availability and integrity of network services in a dynamic, cloud-enabled environment.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Security Infrastructure Management: Configure, deploy, and maintain network security systems (firewalls, IDS/IPS, VPN gateways, encryption devices) to safeguard internal networks and cloud environments.
  • Threat Monitoring & Incident Response: Monitor network traffic and logs for suspicious activities; promptly investigate and respond to security incidents or breaches to minimize impact.
  • Vulnerability Assessment: Conduct regular security audits, vulnerability scans, and penetration tests to identify and remediate network weaknesses. Implement patches and updates to address vulnerabilities and ensure systems are protected against emerging threats.
  • Access Control & Policies: Enforce access controls and network segmentation (supporting a Zero Trust Network Access model) by administering firewalls and network access control lists. Develop and update network security policies, standards, and procedures to align with best practices and compliance requirements.
  • Collaboration & Advisory: Work closely with IT infrastructure teams, application developers, and security architects to integrate security measures into new projects and systems. Provide guidance on secure network design and educate team members on security best practices.
  • Documentation & Compliance: Maintain detailed documentation of configurations, incidents, and changes. Ensure all network security measures comply with relevant regulations and industry standards (e.g., NIST, ISO 27001, PCI-DSS) and assist in preparing for security audits.

Required Qualifications & Skills:

  • Education & Background: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or related field (or equivalent work experience).
  • Technical Skills: Strong understanding of networking protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, VPN, etc.) and hands-on experience with network security technologies (firewalls such as Palo Alto/Cisco/Fortinet, IDS/IPS, VPN solutions, SIEM tools). Proficiency in configuring and managing firewalls and routing/switching equipment in complex networks.
  • Security Expertise: Knowledge of cybersecurity principles , threat landscape, and best practices (e.g., Zero Trust architecture, defense-in-depth, encryption, secure network design ). Ability to perform log analysis, intrusion detection, malware analysis basics, and incident handling.
  • Problem-Solving: Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills for diagnosing network and security issues. Ability to respond effectively under pressure during security incidents or outages.
  • Communication & Teamwork: Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams, explain technical issues to non-technical stakeholders, and provide user training or guidance on security policies when needed.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Advanced/Cloud Security: Experience with cloud security (AWS, Azure, or GCP networking and security services) or secure network design in hybrid cloud environments . Familiarity with SASE (Secure Access Service Edge) frameworks or software-defined networking is a plus.
  • Automation & Scripting: Scripting or automation skills (e.g., Python, PowerShell) to automate network/security tasks and improve efficiency in security operations.
  • Advanced Education: Master’s degree in Cybersecurity or Information Systems.

Experience Requirements:

  • Experience: Minimum 5+ years of hands-on experience in network security, cybersecurity engineering, or a related IT infrastructure security role. Proven track record implementing and managing firewalls, IDS/IPS, VPNs, and performing security monitoring and incident response in an enterprise or managed services environment.

Certifications:

  • Industry Certifications: Professional certifications are highly advantageous . Preferred certifications include CISSP, CISM (for security management knowledge) or CEH, GIAC (for technical security skills). Vendor-specific certifications such as Palo Alto Networks PCNSE/PCNSA are also valuable and demonstrate expertise in relevant technologies.

title: Senior Database Engineer / Lead DBA (DB2 LUW & Cloud Migration) – Bilingual (EN/PT)
description:
We are hiring for a USA company:


Senior Database Engineer / Lead DBA (DB2 LUW & Cloud Migration) – Bilingual (EN/PT)


About the Role:

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Database Administrator (DBA) to join our Global Mainframe DB2 LUW team. This is not a typical application development role; we are looking for a \"under-the-hood\" expert who understands database internals, performance optimization, and the complexities of migrating data between NoSQL and Relational environments.

As a technical lead, you will manage high-stakes backend operations, automate audit compliance, and guide the team through complex data mapping and environment refreshes.

What You Will Do

  • Core Administration: Perform deep-dive backend management of DB2 LUW (Linux, Unix, Windows) environments.
  • Environment Management: Execute test environment refreshes and manage data flow from Archive (AR) environments into active test streams.
  • Modernization & Migration: Lead the charge in migrating data from NoSQL to Relational databases, focusing on complex data mapping, relationship building, and schema design.
  • Cloud & NoSQL: Manage tasks related to AWS RDS and NoSQL platforms, ensuring high availability and performance.
  • Automation & Compliance: Develop automation scripts for audit compliance and security protocols.
  • Performance Tuning: Act as the subject matter expert for advanced SQL tuning and database optimization.
  • Mentorship: Provide technical guidance and leadership to junior and mid-level engineers.

Required Qualifications

  • Language: Native or professional fluency in both English and Portuguese is mandatory.
  • Mainframe DB2 LUW
  • Expertise in DB2 LUW: Extensive experience in backend DB2 LUW administration (not just interfacing via apps).
  • Migration Experience: Proven track record of migrating data between different architectures (Relational vs. NoSQL).
  • Cloud Infrastructure: Hands-on experience with Amazon RDS and NoSQL databases.
  • Advanced Tuning: Expert-level ability to diagnose and resolve complex SQL performance issues.
  • Location: Remote friendly—we value your skillset over your physical location.

They will ensure marketing activities line up with strategies developed and ultimately translate plans to the sales team for execution. They need to ensure the follow steps are covered:

  • Identify high-value target accounts – Identify key accounts that have the potential to contribute the most to the revenue of your company.
  • Conduct research on those accounts - Get a good snapshot of customer needs and pain points, as well as where they are in their customer journey.
  • Develop customized marketing campaigns - Using information you learned in the research phase to inform your strategy, develop creative assets that will resonate with the target account.
  • Run customized marketing campaigns - Launch your campaigns to the target account.
  • Measure customized marketing campaigns - Analyze the data to see how your campaigns are performing.


  • Online Marketing

Will be in charge of creating localized content regularly update the following marketing channels in their assigned region.

  • Webinars
  • SEO – Quarterly updates on the regional assigned webpage
  • Social media – Weekly updates on social media platforms in where they are based – language will depend on where they are based
  • Email marketing – Monthly articles that can be distributed for sales use in their regions.


  • Offline Marketing

Will handle the planning and implementation of offline marketing tasks in the assigned region which could cover

  • Exhibitions
  • Roadshows
  • Print (Quarterly updates)
  • PowerPoint presentations (Company introductions, products or service introductions)


  • Public Relations
  • Build up media relations and ‘Distribution Media List’ for future press release distribution in their assigned region.
  • Ensure appearance on at least one reputable news website in their assigned region.


Qualifications (Education/Knowledge/Working Experience)


  • Master’s degree in a Marketing related discipline.
  • Around 10 years of experience
  • Knowledgable in hands on B2B2C marketing as well as the consumer market in the beverage industry.


Skills Needed


Market Research and Analysis: The ability to conduct thorough market research, analyze data, and draw actionable insights is crucial for understanding the target market, consumer behavior, and industry trends.

Strategic Planning: Regional Marketing Managers must be adept at developing and executing marketing strategies that align with overall business objectives. This includes setting clear goals, defining KPIs, and creating actionable plans.

Team Leadership and Management: Effective leadership skills are important for managing and motivating a team of marketing professionals. This includes providing guidance, setting expectations, and facilitating collaboration.

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Regional Marketing Managers need to work closely with various departments like sales, product development, and supply chain to ensure that marketing initiatives are aligned with overall business operations.

Brand Management: They should have the ability to maintain and enhance the brand image in the specified region. This involves ensuring consistency in messaging, visual identity, and customer experience.

Campaign Management: This skill involves planning, executing, and optimizing marketing campaigns. It requires the ability to set clear objectives, target the right audience, and measure the effectiveness of campaigns.

Budget Management: Effective allocation and management of marketing budgets are essential for maximizing return on investment (ROI) and ensuring that resources are used efficiently.

Data Analysis and Interpretation: Proficiency in using data analytics tools to measure campaign performance, track key metrics, and derive actionable insights is crucial for making informed marketing decisions.

Communication Skills: Strong written and verbal communication skills are necessary for conveying marketing messages effectively to various stakeholders, including team members, executives, and external partners.

Adaptability and Flexibility: The ability to adapt to changing market conditions, consumer preferences, and industry trends is vital for staying competitive and achieving long-term success.

Problem-Solving Skills: Regional Marketing Managers should be able to identify challenges and develop creative solutions to overcome them. This includes being resourceful and thinking critically.

Cultural Awareness and Sensitivity: Especially in a regional role, understanding and respecting cultural nuances and preferences is important for tailoring marketing strategies to specific markets.

Time Management: Effectively prioritizing tasks and managing time to meet deadlines is essential in a fast-paced marketing environment.

Tech-Savviness: Familiarity with marketing technology tools and platforms, as well as proficiency in relevant software and applications, is important for executing marketing initiatives efficiently.

Negotiation Skills: The ability to negotiate and build partnerships with external stakeholders, such as agencies, vendors, and media outlets, can be crucial for successful marketing campaigns.

title: Quality Assurance Tester
description:
Position: QA Lead / Test Engineer ( Remote)


Location: Rio Di Janeiro, Brazil


Duration - Full time


Salary - Competitive


Job Description

Do you have a strong background in quality assurance, a structured approach to testing, and want to join one of the largest technology companies in the Nordics? Then this is the role for you.

We are looking for a Quality Assurance Engineer who wants to be part of Tieto Tech Consulting . Tieto Tech Consulting works as a true partner, solving clients’ toughest technology challenges and delivering reliable outcomes that drive measurable results. By combining engineering excellence with disciplined quality practices, we support customers developing and operating critical digital platforms.

In this role, you will work in close collaboration with product, engineering, and design teams, ensuring high quality, reliability, and scalability of backend services in a modern cloud-based environment.

When joining Tieto Tech Consulting as a Quality Assurance Engineer, you will

  • Partner with product, engineering, and design teams to refine user stories, ensuring acceptance criteria are clear, complete, and testable.
  • Conduct daily evaluations of the QA swimlane in JIRA for new feature work and collaborate with engineers to execute test cycles.
  • Design, develop, and document comprehensive test plans and test cases for new and existing backend services.
  • Develop and maintain Postman API tests and automated integration test suites targeting backend services and data flows across AWS components (SQS, SNS, DynamoDB, EventBridge).
  • Implement and manage API contract testing to validate integrations and ensure data consistency across internal and external services.
  • Design, execute, and maintain performance, load, and stress tests for critical backend infrastructure to ensure scalability and reliability.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to define and test security, access control, and compliance requirements (e.g. HIPAA) for backend services handling sensitive data.
  • Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions) to establish continuous quality gates and support safe, frequent deployments.
  • Manage initial release completion, acting as the first quality gate by approving tickets when testing passes or returning them for rework when defects are identified.
  • Collaborate with QA Engineers across squads to ensure a consistent and high-quality experience for both patient- and provider-facing features.


Who we are looking for

  • Experienced QA professional with 5+ years of experience in startup or fast-paced environments, combining strong manual testing skills with automated testing capabilities.
  • At least 3 years of hands-on experience testing AWS-based backend architectures using Kubernetes.
  • Strong understanding of testing patterns for distributed systems and AWS services such as SQS, SNS, DynamoDB, and EventBridge .
  • Proficiency in a modern programming language such as Python, Java, or TypeScript for writing and maintaining automated test suites.
  • Proven experience designing and implementing automated integration, end-to-end, and component tests .
  • Experience with performance, load, and stress testing applied to backend infrastructure.
  • Hands-on experience with API contract testing frameworks .
  • Working knowledge of CI/CD principles and experience integrating automated tests into deployment pipelines.
  • Familiarity with agile development practices and bug tracking tools (e.g. JIRA, BrowserStack ).
  • Strong analytical mindset with a continuous improvement approach.
  • Detail-oriented in test execution and thorough in documentation.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively within cross-functional teams.


We offer

We offer professional growth, meaningful projects, an open culture, and a strong work-life balance. You will have the opportunity to work in a growing and future-oriented sector, contributing to high-impact digital solutions. We provide a hybrid work model as part of our culture and way of working, and we believe in curiosity and continuous learning as technology evolves.

title: Business Development Manager/Director
description:
PingPong is on a mission to digitize trade, simplifying global growth for businesses. With $300B+ in payments processed, we're one of the world’s leading cross-border platforms – and we’re just getting started.

PingPong currently has 38 offices in 15 countries and over 1,500 employees. Our international presence helps businesses solve complex payment needs in every major economy across all time zones.


Now, we're scaling and looking for a BD Manager/Director to own the strategy, pipeline, and partnerships that will power our next phase of growth.


WHAT’S THE CHALLENGE?


You will take ownership for growing our customers and revenue in the region. You’ll land high-impact deals with banks, fintechs, platforms and enterprises. You’ve got the commercial sharpness to close complex deals.


WHO YOU'LL BE WORKING WITH


You’ll partner closely with our local Compliance, Product, Marketing and operations teams to build a cohesive user journey that delivers the right product to the right users, at the right time. You’ll also collaborate with colleagues across US, EU and other regions and with Group HQ teams.


WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING


  • Build and execute our BD strategy across the LATAM with a focus on financial institutions, platforms and enterprise clients.
  • Maintain a high-quality pipeline across identified target verticals, focusing on high-impact deals, and think through supporting business development strategies.
  • Own the full sales cycle for closing new partners – from sourcing and qualification to leading the definition of the solution for the partner and negotiating the commercials, all the way through to go-live.
  • Pitch our API-first platform, solving real cross-border pain points.
  • Lead commercial and legal negotiations with C-level execs.
  • Work to improve our go-to-market approach, refining messaging, pricing strategy, and pitch materials based on feedback from partners and insights about competitors.
  • Collaborate internally, sharing feedback and insights from the LATAM market to product teams and senior management to inform roadmap and investment decisions.
  • Continuously refine our go-to-market playbook based on what works.

title: Analista Pleno de IAM

  • Conhecimento em Microsoft Defender for Identity, e demais ferramentas de IAM para ambientes híbridos e multicloud (On Prem, Azure, AWS, GCP);
  • Fluência em inglês;
  • Conhecimento em normas e boas práticas de segurança da informação (ex: ISO 27001, NIST, etc).

(CyberArk, Senha Segura, BeyondTrust, SailPoint, Okta, Microsoft EntraID, etc).

title: Marketing Specialist
description:
About Mosaic Puzzles

Mosaic Puzzles is a jigsaw puzzle company based in Alpharetta, Georgia. We design and build unique wooden puzzles where every piece is part of the story. Our collections blend intricate art, clever cut designs, and premium craftsmanship.


We’re a fast-paced, growing startup led by former Uber and Amazon team members, and we’re looking for someone excited to move quickly and contribute ideas that make a real impact.


Check our website for more information:


Position Overview

We’re looking for a creative, detail-oriented, and results-driven Marketing Specialist to join our team. This role combines strong execution skills with analytical thinking and excellent project management.


This role supports the planning and execution of marketing initiatives across multiple channels including email, SMS, social media, and website content. The ideal candidate is highly organized, comfortable working with data, and able to manage multiple marketing projects simultaneously.


You will work closely with other company departments to execute campaigns, analyze performance, and continuously improve how customers discover and engage with our products.


Key Responsibilities


Marketing Strategy & Campaign Execution

  • Assist in the planning and execution of marketing campaigns across email, SMS, social media, website content, and seasonal promotions.
  • Coordinate campaign timelines and marketing calendars to support product launches, seasonal initiatives, and brand campaigns.
  • Support lifecycle marketing initiatives including newsletters, SMS campaigns, product launches, and promotional moments.
  • Collaborate with the team to identify marketing opportunities and propose ideas that improve campaign performance.



Content & Brand Communication

  • Write clear, engaging copy for newsletters, SMS campaigns, social media, blog posts, and other marketing materials.
  • Maintain a consistent brand voice across all marketing channels.
  • Coordinate content calendars aligned with seasonal themes, product launches, and marketing priorities.
  • Monitor social media conversations and user-generated content to identify engagement opportunities.


Digital Marketing & Analytics

  • Track and analyze campaign performance across email, SMS, social media, and website channels.
  • Interpret marketing data and provide actionable insights to improve campaign performance.
  • Assist with SEO initiatives including keyword research, content optimization, and website improvements.
  • Support customer surveys and feedback analysis to help inform product and marketing decisions.


Project Management & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Manage multiple marketing projects and deadlines simultaneously.
  • Work with designers, photographers, videographers, and other cross-functional partners to prepare creative briefs and campaign assets.
  • Ensure marketing initiatives are delivered on time and aligned with campaign goals.
  • Maintain a high level of organization and attention to detail across all marketing initiatives.


Requirements

  • Fluent in English (C1 level or higher). Exceptional written and spoken communication is essential.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field.
  • 3+ years of experience in marketing, digital marketing, or content marketing.
  • Solid understanding of digital marketing analytics and performance tracking .
  • Strong organizational and project management skills.
  • Experience working with email and SMS marketing platforms such as Mailchimp, Attentive, or similar tools.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and shifting priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Proactive mindset with the ability to suggest ideas and take initiative.
  • Strong copywriting skills with a knack for storytelling and brand voice.
  • Experience managing social media accounts and understanding platform best practices.
  • Solid understanding of digital marketing principles, including email marketing and social content strategy.
  • Knowledge of SEO is a plus.


How to Apply

Candidates must submit their resumes in English. Applications submitted in other languages will not be considered.


Mosaic Cultural Values Alignment

The ideal candidate will embody Mosaic’s cultural values, including:

  • Owner’s Mindset: Working hard, helping others, and proactively contributing.
  • Process Orientation: Showing your work and thinking ahead.
  • Moving Quickly: Taking initiative and being proactive.
  • Taking Responsibility: Owning your actions.
  • Valuing Ideas Over Hierarchy: Contributing creatively and openly.
  • Continuous Improvement: Always seeking better ways to work.
  • Doing the Right Thing: Acting with integrity.
  • Believing in Meritocracy: Recognizing and rewarding performance.
  • Resourcefulness: Finding cost-effective and practical solutions.

title: Analista de Segurança da Informação Sênior (Governança e GRC)
description:
Prazer, Grupo SBF

Para nós, esporte é mais que só a prática: é movimento. Ele tem o poder de mover as pessoas pelo exercício, pela paixão pelo time do coração, pela diversão de uma aula de dança, pela força de marcas icônicas. Por vermos a potência do esporte em todas as suas expressões, trabalhamos juntos com garra e energia para construir o primeiro ecossistema de esporte do mundo, reunindo diversas possibilidades para que as pessoas sejam envolvidas e impactadas pelo poder de se movimentar. Quando você pensar em esporte, pode ter certeza: o Grupo SBF estará ali. Seja por meio das lojas e do e-commerce da Centauro, a maior varejista esportiva multimarcas da América Latina; da Fisia, distribuidora oficial da Nike no Brasil, da FitDance e da OneFan, aqui o movimento não para. Praticante ou entusiasta, fã ou apaixonado: o Grupo SBF é pra você. Somos saudavelmente inconformados, fazedores e convictos da importância de levar o movimento para cada vez mais gente. Se você se move por esporte, ou é movido por ele, temos um convite: que tal também trabalhar por ele?

Ficou interessado(a)? Vem saber mais!


Dia a dia:

Foco: Governança, Riscos, Controles e Regulamentações

Atuar de forma estratégica no fortalecimento da governança de Segurança da Informação, assegurando aderência a regulamentações, frameworks e normas aplicáveis (LGPD, PCI DSS, ISO 27001/27002, NIST, entre outras), promovendo gestão eficaz de riscos, controles internos e conformidade regulatória em alinhamento com os objetivos do negócio.


Principais Responsabilidades:


Governança e Compliance

  • Desenvolver, revisar e manter políticas, normas e procedimentos de Segurança da Informação.
  • Garantir aderência a frameworks como ISO 27001/27002, NIST CSF, CIS Controls e PCI DSS.
  • Apoiar e conduzir auditorias internas e externas.
  • Atuar na sustentação de certificações e avaliações regulatórias.
  • Apoiar o programa de adequação e sustentação à LGPD.
  • Apoiar na avaliação de Privacy by Design e Security by Design.


Gestão de Riscos e Controles

  • Conduzir análises de riscos de segurança (técnicos, operacionais e regulatórios).
  • Definir, implementar e monitorar controles internos de segurança.
  • Avaliar riscos de terceiros e fornecedores críticos.
  • Elaborar planos de tratamento de riscos e acompanhar sua execução.
  • Manter matriz de riscos atualizada e integrada à estratégia corporativa.


Regulamentações e Normas

  • Atuar nos temas relacionados a PCI DSS.
  • Garantir aderência a requisitos regulatórios (LGPD, normas contratuais).
  • Traduzir requisitos regulatórios em controles técnicos e processuais aplicáveis.
  • Apoiar áreas de negócio na interpretação de requisitos de segurança.


Integração com Áreas Internas

  • Trabalhar em parceria com Jurídico, Compliance, Auditoria, Tecnologia, Privacidade e áreas de negócio.
  • Apoiar comitês de risco e segurança.
  • Contribuir com indicadores, dashboards executivos e relatórios estratégicos.


Perfil Esperado

  • Visão estratégica de segurança alinhada ao negócio.
  • Forte capacidade analítica e de priorização baseada em risco.
  • Comunicação clara para públicos técnicos e executivos.
  • Capacidade de estruturar processos e elevar maturidade organizacional.
  • Mentalidade colaborativa e orientada a governança preventiva.


Requisitos Técnicos


Obrigatórios:

  • Experiência sólida em Governança, Riscos e Compliance (GRC).
  • Vivência com ISO 27001/27002 e/ou NIST.
  • Experiência em auditorias e avaliação de controles.
  • Conhecimento em gestão de riscos corporativos.

Diferenciais:

  • Certificações como: CISM, CRISC, ISO 27001 LA/LI, PCI ISA.
  • Experiência em varejo, e-commerce ou meios de pagamento.
  • Experiência com PCI DSS
  • Experiência com ferramentas de GRC.


Indicadores de Sucesso

  • Evolução do nível de maturidade em segurança.
  • Redução de riscos críticos.
  • Aderência comprovada a PCI DSS e demais normas.
  • Redução de não conformidades em auditorias.
  • Fortalecimento da cultura de governança e controles.


Contexto de Atuação

A posição integra o White Team, com foco em governança, prevenção, controles e maturidade do programa de Segurança da Informação, atuando de forma estratégica e transversal com múltiplas áreas de negócio.

title: Executive Assistant
description:
About Us

We are an industry leader in providing technology solutions in Canada. We are one of the largest technology solutions providers, recognized for our ability to deliver and innovate to meet the changing needs of our clients. Our services include IT consulting, managed services, cloud solutions, infrastructure design and implementation, and software development. We take pride in our ability to provide comprehensive, customized solutions to meet the unique needs of each of our clients.

We currently looking for an Executive Assistant to be a supportive force who empowers our Executive Leadership Team. This role can be operated from fully remote capacity.

This role requires a self-starter with a sense of urgency, exceptional organizational skills, and the ability to manage multiple priorities under pressure. The ideal candidate will be a proactive problem solver with exceptional communication skills and meticulous attention to details. This person should have experience working in an office environment, performing administrative duties, and providing support to executives. Given the dynamic nature of the executive landscape, we rely on executive assistants to be flexible and consistent while maintaining the confidentiality of high-level systems and our day-to-day operations. You will also assist in coordinating company’s leadership planning cadence, general administrative tasks, office management and support various organizational needs. The successful candidate will be extremely organized with outstanding attention to detail, time management, and professional communication skills. In addition, they will have solid overall business acumen, approach every task and challenge with energy and tenacity, and handle confidential information appropriately.


Responsibilities:

  • Schedule and manage meetings and other calendar events, including sending and accepting electronic invitations, as well as creating and distributing relevant materials in advance.

  • Participate in team, management, and executive meetings, take and distribute minutes and action items, and follow up on their completion.
  • Coordinate complex scheduling and calendar management, as well as content and flow of information to senior executives.
  • Being the point of contact for general communications for the Executives they support
  • Assist in drafting and sending communications and correspondence.
  • Create, manage, and file monthly expenses.
  • Assist with travel arrangements and keep track of itineraries.
  • Complete reports and assist with special projects as requested.
  • Manage employee vacation calendars for supported teams.
  • Assist in the preparation of presentations.
  • Participate in event planning.
  • Assist with general office management duties.
  • Provide additional support to executive team members, as directed, to ensure that company goals and objectives are accomplished and that operations run efficiently.
  • Support the coordination of personal calendars and activities as requested
  • Provide general administrative duties as requested


Qualifications & Requirements:

  • Education in business or related field is an asset
  • Minimum 3-4 years' experience in an administrative role reporting directly to upper management is preferred
  • Superb written and verbal communication skills
  • Exceptional organizational skills
  • Strong time-management skills and the ability to organize and coordinate multiple projects at once
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and other office productivity tools, with aptitude to learn new software and systems
  • Flexible team player willing to do what it takes to get the job done; adaptable and enjoys a challenge
  • Event coordination experience is an asset

Additional Requirements

  • Must be able to work remotely in Pacific Time Zone – Vancouver, Canada
  • Comply with background check requirements
  • This position requires reliable internet connection, backup power, and the use of personal equipment such as Desktop/laptop, mouse keyboard, additional monitor screens and a headset

title: Técnico de Segurança do Trabalho Sênior
description:
Dover Fueling Solutions (\"DFS\"), uma empresa Dover (NYSE: DOV) composta pelos negócios ClearView, Fairbanks, ProGauge, Tokheim, Wayne Fueling Systems e OPW's Fuel Management Systems, oferece equipamentos avançados de abastecimento de combustíveis, sistemas eletrônicos e pagamento, medição automática de tanques e soluções de gerenciamento de estoque de líquidos para clientes em todo o mundo. Sediada em Austin, Texas, a DFS tem uma presença global significativa, incluindo instalações nos EUA, Reino Unido, Suécia, Itália França, Índia, China e Brasil. Para obter mais informações e conhecer nossa política de privacidade, visite


Sumário:

Atua na implementação do sistema de segurança do trabalho da DFS, revisando e validando programas ocupacionais, bem como analisando as condições e rotinas de trabalho, de forma a revisar procedimentos e estudos que promovam a segurança dos colaboradores. Possui interface direta com a investigação de acidentes/incidentes, gestão ocupacional de colaboradores próprios e terceiros, bem como com o gerenciamento de serviços que tenham por objetivo minimizar os riscos laborais.


Descrição:

  • Suportar a implantação e acompanhamento das normas legais aplicáveis, em matéria de Segurança do Trabalho.
  • Organizar e controlar a documentação de colaboradores próprios e terceiros, no que tange a temática relacionada a Segurança do Trabalho, inclusive incluindo a mobilização de colaboradores terceiros em plataformas digitais próprias dos clientes.
  • Suportar a elaboração de escopos para contratação de serviços relacionados a Segurança do Trabalho.
  • Desenvolver estudos sobre oportunidades na gestão de EPIs, analisando a qualidade, tempo de vida útil e funcionalidade dos modelos em uso pelos colaboradores da DFS.
  • Inspecionar instalações e equipamentos da empresa, observando as condições de trabalho, visando identificar condições inseguras e recomendar normas preventivas, utilizando a ferramenta JSA Kaizen em suas análises.
  • Elaborar, organizar e conduzir treinamentos, palestras, ações e campanhas de conscientização visando fortalecer a cultura de segurança.
  • Investigar incidentes e acidentes, relatando em ferramentas de gestão corporativa as ocorrências, bem como participando do processo de recomendação de melhorias preventivas e corretivas.
  • Participar ativamente (desde a elaboração e revisão de Análise Preliminar de Riscos e MOC até o acompanhamento da execução) de projetos multidisciplinares, inclusive junto com a CIPA, Manutenção e Engenharia Industrial, de forma a contribuir para o desenvolvimento destes sob a perspectiva da segurança do trabalho.
  • Revisar os Procedimentos Operacionais e Instruções de Trabalho sob a perspectiva da segurança do trabalho.
  • Manter organizado, de forma a ter rastreabilidade, os indicadores que suportam a cultura de segurança, como por exemplo apurando mensalmente a quantidade de horas destinadas a treinamentos de segurança, bem como quantidades e condições de incidentes e/ou acidentes (com afastamento e sem afastamento).
  • Suportar as demandas relacionadas ao controle de acesso da DFS.
  • Elaborar PPPs em atendimento as demandas internas e externas.
  • Atender ao programa corporativo de cultura de segurança, suportando no desenvolvimento do programa, desde a execução das atividades previstas até o registro das evidências.
  • Executar outras tarefas correlatas, a critério do superior imediato.

Formação:

  • Segundo Grau - Técnico de Segurança do Trabalho

Experiência:

Diferencial ter atuado em indústrias grau 3.

Conhecimentos Específicos/Habilidades:

  • Pacote Office
  • Inglês intermediário
  • Recomendado: Conhecimento em normas ISO 9000 / ISO 14000 /ISO 45000 / OHSAS 18001
  • Diferencial: Atuação em Projetos de Ergonomia, Higiene Ocupacional, Adequação de Máquinas à NR-12; NR-10, Área Classificada e Gestão de Tráfego.


Todos os candidatos qualificados receberão consideração pelo emprego sem discriminação com base na raça, cor, religião, sexo, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, origem nacional, deficiência, idade, informação genética, ou quaisquer outros fatores proibidos por lei.

title: Senior Database Administrator — OLTP & OLAP Databases
description:
Senior Database Administrator — OLTP & OLAP Databases


Location: Ukraine, Armenia, Moldova, Brazil(Remote)


Our trusted high-growth healthcare technology partner is seeking a talented Data Engineer to join their dynamic team. This innovative company is dedicated to revolutionizing the healthcare industry through cutting-edge technology solutions.


About the Role


We're hiring a Senior DBA to own the database layer across our production systems — OLTP relational databases as the operational store and an OLAP columnar database for analytics. Data flows between them via a CDC pipeline (Debezium → Kafka) managed by our infrastructure team. You'll own what's on both ends: schema design, data modeling, query performance, and analytics enablement.

This is a high-ownership role. You'll be the technical authority on how our data is structured, how it performs, and how schema changes propagate safely from OLTP to OLAP stores. You'll work closely with application teams, data consumers, and the infrastructure team that operates the CDC pipeline.


What You'll Own

  • OLTP schema design: Data modeling, indexing strategies, migration planning, and performance tuning across multiple database clusters
  • OLAP data modeling: Table design, materialized views, partitioning, and query optimization for analytics workloads
  • Schema evolution: Coordinating schema changes with the infrastructure team to ensure safe propagation through the CDC pipeline
  • Query performance: Profiling, optimization, and capacity planning across both OLTP and OLAP stores
  • Data integrity: Validation, reconciliation, and monitoring to ensure consistency between OLTP and OLAP stores
  • Technical leadership: Standards for schema management, review processes, mentoring, and cross-team collaboration


Tech Stack

  • OLTP: Aurora MySQL 8.0 (multiple clusters, multi-AZ)
  • OLAP: ClickHouse 25.x
  • CDC Pipeline: Debezium 3.3.2 → Kafka 4.0 → ClickHouse
  • Observability: Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry
  • Cloud: AWS (EKS, RDS, S3)


Requirements

  • 5+ years as a DBA or data engineer, 2+ in a senior/lead role
  • Strong experience with OLTP relational databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle, or similar) — schema design, indexing, query optimization, replication, migrations
  • Strong experience with OLAP/columnar databases (ClickHouse, Vertica, Greenplum, Druid, Doris, or similar) — table design, materialized views, partitioning, query optimization Deep SQL expertise across both transactional and analytical query patterns
  • Experience with schema migration strategies in environments with downstream consumers (CDC, ETL, replication)
  • Familiarity with data consistency challenges between OLTP and OLAP systems



Nice to Have

  • Experience with Debezium or CDC systems — understanding how schema changes affect downstream pipelines
  • Healthcare data or regulated environments (HIPAA, SOC2)
  • Data quality frameworks — validation, reconciliation, anomaly detection
  • dbt, Airflow, or similar transformation/orchestration tools
  • Performance benchmarking and capacity planning for OLAP databases
  • Experience with AWS RDS/Aurora operational features — Parameter Groups, Performance Insights.


Benefits:

  • Competitive salary to recognise and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

title: Technical Team Lead – Windows Network Services
description:
Technical Team Lead – Windows Network Services

12month contract + Extensions

Brazil

$37/hr - $46/hr

**Exact compensation may vary based on several factors, including skills, experience, and education.

**Benefit packages for this role will start on the 31st day of employment and include medical, dental, and vision insurance, as well as HSA, FSA, and DCFSA account options, and 401k retirement account access with employer matching. Employees in this role are also entitled to paid sick leave and/or other paid time off as provided by applicable law.



The Technical Team Lead – Windows Network Services is responsible for the day-to-day operation of Active Directory and related network identity services in their scope. This includes managing domain controllers, implementing Group Policy changes, ensuring DNS/DHCP are running smoothly, and responding to any incidents affecting authentication or network directory services. They implement the Architect’s designs and standards on the ground, making configuration changes and overseeing maintenance. Additionally, they support integrations (e.g., if a new application needs AD integration or certificates) and handle routine upgrades and patches for AD and its companion services.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Operate and Monitor AD Environments: Oversee the health of AD domains and domain controllers in the region. This includes monitoring replication, FSMO roles, AD logs, and ensuring backups and disaster recovery procedures for AD are in place.
  • Implement GPO Changes: Create or update Group Policy Objects as needed, following the architectural guidelines. Test GPO changes and roll them out, managing GPO conflicts or inheritance issues. Delegate GPO management appropriately.
  • Certificate and Naming Services: Manage the day-to-day of AD Certificate Services (issuing/revoking certificates, root CA maintenance) and core networking services like DNS, DHCP, and NTP servers. Ensure DNS zones are correct and replicated, DHCP scopes are managed, and time synchronization is consistent.
  • Security Control Implementation: Apply and uphold security controls as defined by the Architect. For example, enforce the use of privileged access workstations or other controls for AD admins, ensure service accounts are being used properly, and implement changes from any AD security assessments (such as patching LDAP signing issues, etc.)..
  • Incident Response: Act as the escalation point for any incidents involving AD or WNS services. Lead troubleshooting for outages or cyber incidents (like a suspected AD compromise). Coordinate with Security Operations if needed to contain and remediate issues.
  • Support Integrations: Work with other IT teams to integrate systems with AD (for authentication/SSO) or to set up new trust relationships. Assist in configuration of SSO, MFA, or PAM solutions as they interface with AD.
  • Continuous Improvement: Identify areas to improve performance or stability of AD and WNS (e.g., decommissioning legacy domain controllers, fine-tuning DNS configurations, optimizing login scripts or group policy processing). Implement improvements and document changes.


Qualifications & Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, or similar (or equivalent practical experience).
  • 7+ years of hands-on experience in Windows Server administration and Active Directory management. Familiarity with global AD deployments is a plus.
  • Strong experience with core network services on Windows (DNS, DHCP, DFS, Certificate Services). Able to configure and troubleshoot these services expertly.
  • Experience in an enterprise IT operations or infrastructure team, with responsibilities including change management and incident management for critical services.
  • Knowledge of identity integrations (how AD works with Azure AD/Azure AD Connect, SSO protocols like SAML/Kerberos, etc.), and experience implementing MFA or PAM in conjunction with AD is beneficial.

title: Business Development Manager
description:
Native Teams is a global platform for work payments and employment. Beyond managing payroll, compliance, and taxes, we integrate financial tools to maximise the value of every work payment, worldwide.


We are expanding our global team and looking for a Business Development Manager to bring their wider knowledge and help us get our product and service more widely known and used.


In this role, you will play a key role in driving new business and revenue growth by managing the full sales cycle from outbound outreach to discovery, solution design, negotiation, and closing. You will work closely with prospective clients to understand their needs, educate them on Native Teams' solutions, and guide them through the decision-making and onboarding process. Your goal is to acquire new customers and expand revenue within assigned markets and ICPs.


Would you like to take on a new challenge in the field of sales in a successful, fast-growing global start-up?


Location: Remote

Salary range: Flexible


Key Responsibilities


Outbound & Pipeline Generation

  • Proactively identify and engage prospective clients through outbound outreach, networking, events, and other channels.
  • Execute outbound strategies tailored to defined ICPs and market segments.
  • Research accounts for understanding business context, hiring plans, and potential use cases.


Inbound Handling

  • Take qualified inbound requests and convert them into active opportunities.
  • Respond promptly and professionally in line with internal SLAs.
  • Run a structured qualification to assess fit and readiness.


Discovery & Consultative Selling

  • Conduct high-quality discovery calls to understand client goals, blockers, compliance considerations, and service requirements.
  • Educate prospects on how Native Teams supports global employment, payroll, and work payments.
  • Present tailored solutions, product overviews, and value propositions to multiple stakeholders.


Solution Design & Pricing

  • Prepare proposals, pricing scenarios, and competitive a/b options in line with commercial guidelines.
  • Guide clients on hiring models (EoR, Contractor of Record, etc.) and explain operational processes.
  • Work cross-functionally to ensure feasibility for legal, product, and finance-related questions.


Negotiation & Closing

  • Manage contract negotiations and commercial discussions through to signature.
  • Navigate procurement timelines, internal approvals, and stakeholder alignment.
  • Close new business and achieve monthly/quarterly revenue targets.


Pipeline Ownership & Forecasting

  • Maintain an up-to-date sales pipeline with accurate stage management and forecasting.
  • Log all activities, updates, and communication history in the CRM.
  • Prioritize high-impact opportunities while balancing follow-ups and nurturing.


Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with Customer Success, Legal, Finance, and Product teams to ensure a smooth client transition post-close.
  • Relay client feedback to internal stakeholders to support product and process improvements.
  • Represent the sales voice in outbound campaigns, ICP targeting, and revenue initiatives.


Market Feedback & Learning

  • Stay informed on industry trends, competitive offerings, and compliance developments.
  • Share insights from the market to improve positioning, messaging, and go-to-market strategy.



Requirements


  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or related field (preferred, not mandatory).
  • Experience in outbound sales, B2B sales, or full-cycle sales roles.
  • Strong communication and client-facing presentation skills.
  • Confident running discovery calls, demos, and negotiations.
  • Familiarity with CRM systems (e.g., HubSpot) and sales outreach tools.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple deals in parallel.
  • Ability to navigate ambiguity, work autonomously, and drive outcomes.
  • Fluency in English, written and spoken.



Benefits


  • Dynamic and interesting work in an early-stage, funded startup.
  • Ability to influence the next stages of our growth.
  • Experience working in the ever-changing world of FinTech.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.
  • Flexible work environment.



Join our team at Native Teams, a fast-growing global start-up. We're looking for driven, passionate individuals to join us as we continue to expand our reach and impact.


At Native Teams, we pride ourselves on our dynamic and supportive work environment, where we encourage personal and professional growth. We believe in hiring talented individuals from diverse backgrounds, not only because we should do it but because fresh perspectives improve our team and our decisions. Our multicultural team is made up of young, energetic, and positive people who are passionate about what they do.


As part of our team, you’ll reflect the people we serve and will have the opportunity to work with thousands and impact millions of lives around the world.


If you're looking for a challenging and rewarding career and the chance to be part of a team that's making a real difference in the world, then we want to hear from you.

title: Category Manager
description:
We are hiring an analytically elite Category Manager / Category Analyst to serve as the commercial intelligence engine for a fast-growing CPG brand scaling from. This role blends deep category analytics, trade optimization, and retail strategy with storytelling that drives better decisions — internally and with key partners.


You will transform complex datasets — syndicated data (SPINS, Nielsen, IRI), retailer portals (e.g., 84.51°), distributor reporting, and internal systems — into actionable insights that meaningfully improve velocity, trade efficiency, pricing, and distribution performance. This person is the strategic partner to Sales, Marketing, Ops, Finance, and Leadership.


Strategic Importance


  • As we scale nationally and deepen relationships with major retailers and distributors (UNFI, KeHE, C&S, Dot), this role is critical to commercial success by:
  • Elevating category insights as a competitive advantage
  • Strengthening sales pitches with data-backed stories that win distribution
  • Increasing promo ROI through rigorous trade and lift analysis
  • Driving cross-functional alignment on strategy via clear analytics + narratives
  • This role is not just about dashboards — it’s about impact and influence across the business.



Key Responsibilities


  • Syndicated Data + Retailer Insights
  • Own analysis of SPINS, Nielsen/IRI and retailer portal data to understand:
  • Category growth drivers
  • Competitor dynamics
  • Velocity and share trends
  • Translate data into retailer-specific insights for buyers and commercial teams.


Promotion & Trade Effectiveness


  • Measure incremental lift, promo effectiveness, and trade ROI.
  • Partner with Sales and Finance to improve TPM discipline, promotional forecasting and post mortems.
  • Create frameworks to compare promo results vs. baseline and forecast.


Assortment, Pricing, and Space Strategy


  • Recommend SKU rationalization, pricing strategies, and assortment optimization.
  • Partner with Sales/Category buyers on planogram space recommendations.


Distributor & Retail Performance Tracking

Track performance across key channels and distributors (UNFI, KeHE, C&S, Dot), including:


  • Fill rates
  • Retail sell-through
  • Inventory health and void risk


Provide early-warning signals and corrective action recommendations.

Forecasting & Demand Planning Support


  • Improve forecast accuracy and alignment with Supply Chain and Finance.
  • Provide insights that enhance S&OP and promotional planning.


Cross-Functional Analytics & Reporting

Build and maintain executive-ready dashboards in Power BI / Tableau.


Provide cadence reporting (weekly, monthly, quarterly) tailored to:


  • Sales
  • Marketing
  • Finance
  • Operations


Executive Storytelling & Data Communication


  • Translate analytics into structured business narratives that inform strategy and execution.
  • Support pitch materials, competitive heatmaps, and retailer presentations.


Required Experience & Skills


Experience


  • 3–8+ years in CPG analytics, category management, revenue management, or related retail strategy roles.


Proven track record with:


  • Syndicated data platforms (SPINS, Nielsen/IRI)
  • Retailer portals (84.51°, Luminate)
  • Commercial analytics in a growth CPG environment


Technical Skills


  • Advanced Excel (modeling, pivot tables, data transformations)
  • Power BI / Tableau dashboard creation
  • Familiarity with trade spend economics, TPM, and promotional lift frameworks


Capabilities


  • Strong analytical rigor and ability to build structured insights
  • Excellent communication and executive presence
  • Storytelling that transforms data into selling narratives


Preferred Experience


  • Experience in frozen or high-velocity CPG categories
  • Prior work with national retailers and major distributors
  • Startup or high-growth CPG environment

Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively.



THE ROLE

The Manager I of Engineering plays a key leadership role, directly managing a small team of software engineers. This role is responsible for ensuring timely delivery of high-quality software projects, fostering a collaborative and inclusive team culture, and supporting the professional growth of engineers.

In addition to leading day-to-day execution, this manager contributes to tactical decision-making, participates in architectural discussions, and ensures engineering efforts are aligned with project goals. They collaborate closely with product, design, and cross-functional stakeholders to deliver solutions that support Syniti’s broader mission.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

• Manage and support a team of software engineers, ensuring projects are delivered on time and within scope.

• Provide coaching, mentorship, and regular performance feedback to support individual growth.

• Guide the team in applying engineering best practices, including code reviews, testing, and secure development.

• Participate in architectural and technical design discussions, ensuring sound engineering decisions.

• Collaborate closely with product and cross-functional teams to align priorities and deliver value.

• Help shape a positive and inclusive team culture that fosters engagement, learning, and innovation.

• Identify and address delivery risks, blockers, or process gaps within the team’s scope.

• Contribute to hiring and onboarding of new engineers, and support team scaling efforts.



WHAT IT TAKES

• Proven experience as a team lead or first-line engineering manager in a software development environment.

• Strong technical foundation in modern software development (e.g., C#, Go, React, TypeScript, AWS).

• Familiarity with agile development methodologies, DevOps practices, and software delivery processes.

• Excellent communication and collaboration skills across technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Demonstrated ability to coach, mentor, and support the growth of engineering team members.

• Experience participating in technical design, architecture reviews, and secure development practices.

• Comfortable working in a fast-paced, distributed, and cross-functional environment.


Be fully aligned to our core values:

• Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have.

• Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday.

• Take Action - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day.

• Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family.



WHAT WE OFFER

• Trust in your talent. At Syniti you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our style.

• Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story.

• Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone.

• Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating with each depicting a different journey and we want to hear them all.

• Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them.

• An open organisation. Titles don’t define access at Syniti. We stay humble regardless of where we sit in the organisation. We want to hear every voice, listen to all the ideas and make sure everyone’s work is seen and valued.



Our Commitment to Inclusion

At Syniti, we’re committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team. We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we’re dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we’re here to support you.

title: Pessoa Coordenadora de Marketing
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.


A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.


Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.


E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.


Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

  • Coordenação do Departamento de Marketing compreendendo Trade, Comunicação, CRM e Programa de Benefícios;
  • Planejamento do calendário anual de campanhas e eventos e elaboração de plano de marketing com o orçamento de despesas de sua área;
  • Controle financeiro;
  • Negociação com parceiros e patrocínios;
  • Interface com agência de publicidade e promoção: elaboração de briefings de campanhas, plano de mídia, comunicação interna do shopping, campanhas promocionais (mecânica, documentação, premiação, prestação de contas);
  • Responsável pela comunicação do shopping com a assessoria de imprensa: aprovação de releases e sugestão de pautas;
  • Preservar a imagem do empreendimento junto ao público em geral e lojistas;
  • Contribuir com a Gerência de Marketing, participando de reuniões sistemáticas com a equipe para avaliação de metas setoriais, acompanhamento dos indicadores de qualidade, desenvolvimento de planos de melhoria contínua e intercâmbio de informações.

  • Diferenciais: MBA em administração, comunicação, marketing, produção de eventos.
  • Pacote Office Avançado;

Você será o elo fundamental entre nossas equipes globais de engenharia, parceiros locais e fornecedores internacionais, garantindo o fornecimento de equipamentos econômicos, em conformidade com as normas e dentro dos prazos estabelecidos para os projetos renováveis.

  • Execução de Compras de Projetos : Traduzir especificações técnicas de projetos solares em planos de compras estruturados, pacotes de RFQ e documentos de licitação; gerenciar estimativas de custos, controle de orçamento e acompanhamento de cronogramas de compras.

  • Coordenação Interequipes : Colaborar estreitamente com equipes de engenharia, gerenciamento de projetos e equipes regionais para alinhar o andamento das compras com marcos do projeto; coordenar logística transfronteiriça, desembaraço aduaneiro e acompanhamento de entregas.
  • Inteligência de Mercado e Conformidade : Acompanhar tendências de mercado, flutuações de preços e riscos na cadeia de suprimentos de equipamentos solares no Brasil; garantir a conformidade das compras com normas locais, códigos de rede e requisitos de certificação de energia renovável.

  • Conhecimento sólido de componentes de sistemas solares fotovoltaicos (módulos, inversores, BESS, estruturas, BOS) e fluxos de trabalho de compras baseados em projetos

title: L3 Support Services Appendix REDHAT
description:
L3 Support Services Appendix REDHAT

Type: Contract

Location: Columbia/ Argentina/ Brazil (We are only considering candidates from the following countries)

Rate: DOE


Job Summary:

Objective:

Responsible for the performance, availability, and reliability of our cloud-based services and underlying infrastructure, acting as a critical technical subject matter expert.

Key Details:

• Skills: Linux (mandatory) with experience in Kubernetes, OpenShift, and OpenStack

• Experience: 7–10 years

• Interview Process: 2 rounds

• Requirements: Immediate

• Candidate has to work in CST OR EST time


Key Responsibilities:

● Manage, troubleshoot, and optimize containerized applications and infrastructure deployed on Kubernetes, Red Hat OpenShift, and OpenStack platforms.

● Serve as the Subject Matter Expert (SME) for core cloud infrastructure technologies, including advanced Linux (CentOS) system administration, Docker/Containers, and complex networking configurations.

● Lead the investigation and resolution of complex, high-severity customer issues, applying strong analytical knowledge to quickly diagnose problems across the entire cloud stack.

● Utilize your expertise to quickly identify root causes and implement effective, durable solutions for customer incidents.

● Prepare and conduct rigorous Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for critical incidents to identify systemic issues and prevent recurrence.

● Develop, test, and maintain robust automation scripts using Python and Ansible to streamline daily operational tasks and improve overall service efficiency.

● Identify and implement automation opportunities to reduce manual effort in maintenance and deployment activities.

● Provide end-to-end Escalation, Monitoring, and Emergency (EME) support, acting as a final escalation point to ensure service availability and meet SLAs.

● Liaise directly with the customer team and internal teams to understand requirements and deliver tailored technical solutions.

● Stay current with industry best practices and emerging technologies in cloud and containerization.

Scheduling:

● Our team operates on a follow-the-sun model, ensuring 24/7 coverage and rapid response times. While this may occasionally require shifts outside typical local business hours, the total work hours will remain consistent with a standard work week.

● A rotational on-call schedule is a mandatory part of this position. On-call experts are responsible for providing immediate support for urgent cases, including direct customer contact (via call/Teams) and prompt engagement in designated war rooms for case investigation and resolution.

● All interventions are performed in live environments and must strictly follow the Standard Network Touch Policy, requiring full awareness and compliance during urgent case resolution.

Required Skills & Qualifications:


● Linux Expertise: Strong knowledge and proven hands-on experience with Linux administration.

● Networking Foundations: Strong knowledge of core networking principles (TCP/IP, routing, load balancing, firewalls) in a cloud environment.

● Containerization & Virtualization: Strong knowledge of Kubernetes orchestration, OpenStack platforms, and Docker/Containerization.

● Problem-Solving Mindset: Possess sharp troubleshooting skills combined with an analytical mindset to dissect and address complex challenges.

● Scripting and Automation: Solid Python scripting skills for task automation and system management.

● Configuration Management: Hands-on experience with Ansible for configuration management.’

● Root Cause Analysis (RCA): Expertise in preparation and implementation of RCAs.

● Escalation and Monitoring: Proven experience with EME (Escalation, Monitoring, and Emergency) management processes.

Preferred Qualifications:

One or more certifications from the list below will be considered an added advantage:

Red Hat Certified Specialist in Cloud Infrastructure (EX210), Red Hat Certified Engineer (RHCE) in Red Hat OpenStack (EX310), RHCSA, RHCE, CKA, EX280 (Red Hat Certified Specialist in OpenShift Administration), EX380 (Red Hat Certified Specialist in OpenShift Automation and API Management).

Communication & Attitude:


● Excellent communication skills (written and verbal) and the ability to articulate complex issues clearly.

● Demonstrated ability to handle customer pressure and manage expectations with a positive, professional attitude.

● Strong team player, self-motivated, and capable of excelling in a high-pressure, dynamic support environment.

title: Analista de planejamento
description:
Empresa multinacional de grande porte está em busca de um Analista de Materiais Sênior para atuar na região do ABC.


Essa posição é confidencial e oferece a oportunidade de integrar um ambiente dinâmico, estratégico e com foco em excelência operacional. Buscamos um profissional experiente, com forte capacidade analítica, visão sistémica e habilidade para garantir níveis ideais de inventário, alinhando demanda, supply chain e operação.


Título do Cargo: Analista de Planejamento de Materiais Sênior


Resumo do Cargo

Estamos em busca de um Analista de Planejamento de Materiais Sênior altamente analítico e orientado a detalhes para supervisionar nossa gestão de inventário e fluxo de materiais de ponta a ponta. Neste cargo, você será responsável por garantir que os requisitos de produção sejam atendidos por meio de planejamento estratégico, coordenação de fornecedores e análise avançada de dados. Você desempenhará um papel fundamental na otimização dos níveis de estoque, redução de desperdícios e mitigação de riscos na cadeia de suprimentos.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Planejamento Estratégico: Desenvolver e executar planos de requisitos de materiais (MRP) para garantir 100% de disponibilidade de componentes para o cronograma de produção.
  • Otimização de Inventário: Gerir a saúde do estoque, equilibrando os níveis de serviço com as metas de capital de giro. Liderar iniciativas para reduzir estoques obsoletos e excedentes (E&O).
  • Gestão de Fornecedores: Colaborar com a área de Compras/Sourcing para monitorar o desempenho dos fornecedores, gerir prazos de entrega (lead times) e resolver faltas críticas de materiais.
  • Melhoria de Processos: Identificar gargalos na cadeia de suprimentos e implementar metodologias Lean ou Six Sigma para otimizar o fluxo de materiais.
  • Análise de Dados e Reportes: Criar e manter dashboards complexos (Power BI/Tableau) para acompanhar KPIs como Giro de Estoque, Fill Rate e Acuracidade de Previsão.
  • Liderança Multifuncional: Atuar como ponte entre Manufatura, Finanças e Logística para alinhar os planos de suprimentos com as previsões de demanda e orçamentos financeiros.
  • Mentoria: Fornecer orientação e suporte técnico para analistas juniores e coordenadores.


Qualificações e Habilidades

  • Formação: Ensino superior completo em Administração, Engenharia de Produção, Logística, Comércio Exterior ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência: Mínimo de 5 anos de experiência em planejamento de materiais, programação de produção ou análise de supply chain (preferencialmente em ambiente industrial).
  • Habilidades Técnicas:
  • Domínio de sistemas ERP (SAP/APO, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics entre outros) com foco nos módulos de Inventário, Compras e Produção, experiência na geração de relatórios de MRP, gestão de estruturas de produtos (BOM) e configuração de gatilhos de reposição automática.
  • Nível especialista em Microsoft Excel (Power Query, Macros, Tabelas Dinâmicas).
  • Experiência com softwares de planejamento de demanda e ferramentas de visualização de dados.
  • Certificações (Diferencial): APICS (CPIM ou CSCP) ou certificação Six Sigma (Green/Black Belt).
  • Habilidades Interpessoais: Fortes táticas de negociação, mentalidade voltada para resolução de problemas e capacidade de atuar sob pressão.
  • Idiomas: Inglês fluente (escrita e conversação) é um diferencial.

Disruptive Talents, a boutique headhunting and strategic recruitment firm, is collaborating with an international Forex brokerage to identify a Client Relations Specialist - Sales Admin Support based in Brazil.

About the Company

A regulated international Forex brokerage operating across multiple jurisdictions, the company provides trading access and infrastructure solutions to professional traders, institutional clients, introducing brokers (IBs), asset managers, and strategic partners. With a growing global footprint and a strong emphasis on technology, compliance, and scalable brokerage solutions, the firm continues to expand its presence in key regional markets, including Colombia, Mexico and Brazil.

What We Are Looking For:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Communications, or a related field.
  • Proven experience in customer service, sales support, or administrative roles.
  • Strong organisational and multitasking skills with attention to detail.
  • Excellent language skills in Spanish, English and Portuguese to ensure smooth communication with clients and vendors.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and CRM software.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and handle customer interactions professionally.


What We Offer:

  • Competitive base salary plus performance-based commission.
  • Exposure to global financial markets and high-value clients.
  • Clear career progression in a fast-growing brokerage environment.
  • Collaborative, performance-oriented culture.


How to Apply:

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
We're looking for a DevOps / Cloud Lead who knows how to design, automate, and operate cloud infrastructure.

This role focuses heavily on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) due to a strategic partnership in that ecosystem. Many of our clients are migrating infrastructure to OCI or need help operating multi-cloud environments.

We need someone who can design solutions, automate processes, and solve infrastructure problems, not just maintain pipelines.



Why this role exists

We have a strategic partnership with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). Clients are asking us to migrate infrastructure to OCI, and many of them also need ongoing DevOps operations and architecture support.

We need someone who can own this technically. Not just executing tasks, but executing the task is an important part of the job as well.

Design solutions. Talk to clients. Automate migrations. Coordinate engineers. And when necessary, jump in and fix things yourself.



TL;DR

You will help lead cloud and DevOps initiatives at Quave. Your job is to:

  • Lead cloud migrations to OCI
  • Design cloud architectures
  • Automate migrations and infrastructure
  • Coordinate DevOps engineers
  • Talk directly to clients
  • Help build repeatable DevOps processes

You must be strong in OCI, comfortable with AWS / Azure / GCP, hands-on, obsessed with automation, and comfortable discussing technical architecture with clients.

English is a plus, not required.



This is not a ticket-based DevOps job

If you're looking for a role where you maintain Jenkins pipelines, restart servers, open support tickets, and wait for instructions, this is not the role for you.

This role is about designing and solving infrastructure problems. We want someone who can look at a system and think:


\"We can automate 80% of this.\"

And then actually build the automation.



What you'll actually do

Cloud Architecture Design infrastructure for systems running in OCI, AWS, Azure, and GCP, migrating from one to another.



Cloud Migrations

A lot of our work will be migrations like AWS → OCI, Azure → OCI, GCP → OCI.

Your job is not just to do the migration, but to help us turn migrations into repeatable processes, scripts, templates, automation and tooling so that each migration becomes easier than the last.



Automation

We want to automate everything that can be automated:

  • Automated infrastructure provisioning
  • Migration scripts
  • CI/CD pipelines
  • Environment replication
  • Monitoring setups

If you like writing scripts that replace hours of manual work, you'll enjoy this role.



Client Discussions

You will often join calls with clients to understand infrastructure problems, design migration strategies, estimate effort, and propose solutions. You must be comfortable discussing technical topics clearly.



Leading DevOps Engineers

As the DevOps work grows, you'll coordinate other engineers working on projects, reviewing architecture, guiding implementations, and ensuring quality.



What we're looking for

You probably have many years working with infrastructure. But more importantly, you have good instincts about systems.

You likely:

  • Love automating infrastructure
  • Hate manual processes
  • Can quickly understand unfamiliar systems
  • Are comfortable debugging production environments
  • Enjoy designing architectures
  • Can communicate clearly with both engineers and clients

You should also be comfortable using AI tools to accelerate your work. Tools like ChatGPT, Claude, and Cursor can dramatically increase productivity when used well. We expect you to take advantage of that.



Technical Expectations

Cloud

  • Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) - important
  • AWS
  • Azure
  • GCP

    • DevOps

    • Docker
    • Kubernetes
    • Terraform or other Infrastructure-as-Code tools
    • CI/CD pipelines
    • Linux systems administration
    • Networking fundamentals

    Automation

    Comfortable writing scripts in Bash, Python, Go, or similar.


    Languages

    Portuguese required. English is a plus as some clients are international, so it may eventually become useful in the future, but it's not required.


    Why work with Quave

    We are a small, profitable, independent company. No investors. No corporate bureaucracy. We focus on doing great work for clients and building great software.

    Things we value: Speed. Quality. Pragmatism. Autonomy.

    Quave literally stands for Quality (Qua) and Velocity (Ve).


    Pay and Benefits

    This is a full-time remote position. Compensation will depend on experience.

    • Fully remote work
    • Flexible hours
    • 22 days paid time off per year
    • Quarterly bonus based on company performance
    • AI allowance for productivity tools

    We work as a distributed team of independent contractors.


    Hiring Process

    • Application review
    • Technical conversation
    • Architecture discussion
    • Conversation(s) with one or more partners
    • This is a leadership role and you will coordinate other engineers as the DevOps work grows. But at Quave our leaders are hands-on. You should be comfortable writing automation and infrastructure code yourself when needed.

title: Immigration Attorney (US-licensed)
description:
About the job

POSITION SPECIFICATION

Position Title: Immigration Attorney (US license is required)

Reporting To: Chief Supervising Attorney

Location: Hybrid (Preferred location: Brazil)

The Company: HAYMAN-WOODWARD GMS


ABOUT US

HAYMAN-WOODWARD GMS is a globally recognized immigration and advisory firm. Based in Dubai, UAE, with offices across 9 countries, we specialize in facilitating seamless global transitions for individuals and businesses. Our expertise in U.S. employment-based immigration law positions us uniquely to navigate complex immigration procedures, enabling our clients to flourish in their chosen international markets.

POSITION SUMMARY

As an Immigration Attorney, you will be instrumental in guiding clients through the multifaceted immigration process. Your role demands a comprehensive understanding of immigration law and exceptional client service skills, ensuring successful outcomes in various legal scenarios. Your responsibilities include:

  • Client Consultation and Advocacy : Providing personalized legal consultation, understanding each client’s unique needs, and advising on the most viable legal options. Your role involves zealous representation of clients' interests, maintaining transparent communication, and filing G-28s on their behalf. Representation includes evaluation of complex eligibility and admissibility issues, RFE/NOID prevention strategy, participation in legal strategy meetings.
  • Case Management and Strategy Development: Leading a diverse range of immigration cases from inception to resolution. This includes strategizing tailored solutions, analyzing case specifics, and foreseeing potential challenges to address them proactively.
  • Preparation and Submission of Cases: Crafting compelling petitions for various immigration applications such as work visas, family-based petitions, adjustment of status, and naturalization. Your meticulous attention to detail is crucial in ensuring accuracy and compliance with current immigration laws. This also involves staying abreast of legal developments and preparing detailed legal briefs and reports.
  • Collaboration and Team Leadership: Working in tandem with paralegals, legal assistants, and other attorneys. You will mentor and oversee junior staff to ensure high-quality, timely casework.
  • Response to Legal Queries: Addressing Requests for Additional Evidence (RFEs), Notices of Intent to Deny (NOIDs), and Notices of Intent to Revoke (NOIRs) from government agencies through detailed analysis and preparation of persuasive responses.
  • Appeals and Legal Motions: Managing appeals and motions to reconsider or reopen cases, crafting comprehensive legal arguments to uphold client positions.

EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS AND EDUCATIONAL BACKGROUND
