description:
Location: Rio de Janeiro, Brazil (Remote)

Employment Type: Full-time


Company Description

AgileHRO is an all-in-one HR, payroll, and mobility platform designed to simplify workforce management for businesses worldwide. Our platform offers efficient solutions for payroll management, onboarding, employee management, and global mobility, with a focus on reducing administrative burdens and ensuring compliance. AgileHRO is trusted globally for its intuitive platform, real-time insights, and exceptional customer support that enable companies to scale effectively. We are committed to empowering businesses and creating a flexible, inclusive, and efficient future of work.


About the Role

We are seeking a highly skilled Technical Recruiter with deep expertise in the Brazilian Oil & Gas market. You will be responsible for managing the full recruitment lifecycle, focusing on high-level Engineering roles and specialized Offshore positions. The ideal candidate understands the complexity of offshore operations and has a strong network of certified professionals ready for deployment.


Key Responsibilities

  • Full-Cycle Recruitment: Manage the end-to-end recruitment process for offshore technical crews, subsea engineers, project managers, and specialized technicians.

  • Stakeholder Management: Partner with Hiring Managers and Operations Leads to define job requirements and provide market intelligence on salary benchmarks.
  • Compliance: Ensure all hiring processes align with Brazilian labor laws (CLT) and specific maritime/offshore regulations.
  • Pipeline Building: Maintain a robust \"bench\" of candidates for rapid mobilization on upcoming offshore projects.


Qualifications

  • Experience: 2 years in recruitment, with at least 3 years focused exclusively on the Oil & Gas / Offshore sector in Brazil.
  • Technical Knowledge: Familiarity with offshore roles (ROV Pilots, Drillers, Rig Managers, Subsea Engineers, HSE Officers).
  • Certification Expertise: Solid understanding of mandatory training requirements for boarding (OPITO standards, Brazilian NRs).
  • Languages: Fluent Portuguese and Advanced/Fluent English (mandatory for reporting and global coordination).
  • Tools: Proficiency with ATS (Applicant Tracking Systems) and advanced Sourcing.


Soft Skills

  • Ability to work under pressure and handle tight mobilization deadlines.
  • Strong communication and negotiation skills.
  • Organization to manage high-volume technical roles.

title: Senior Data Governance Analyst
description:
Job Summary

The Senior Data Governance Analyst is responsible for designing, building, and operationalizing the enterprise Data Governance Program across the full data lifecycle. This role will establish governance structures, data ownership models, classification standards, retention controls, and monitoring capabilities to ensure data is managed, protected, and used in accordance with regulatory, security, and business requirements.


The individual will act as a subject matter expert and program driver, working in a fast-paced environment to rapidly mature data governance capabilities. This role requires deep expertise in data governance frameworks, strong cross-functional leadership, and the ability to execute and deliver measurable outcomes within aggressive timelines.


Key Responsibilities

• Design and mature the enterprise data governance framework, policies, standards, and operating model.

• Establish and maintain data ownership, stewardship, and accountability structures.

• Stand up and manage governance forums, working groups, and reporting mechanisms.

• Build and maintain the enterprise data inventory and data domain model.

• Define requirements for data collection, ownership assignment, and classification at creation.

• Embed governance and classification controls into system development and intake processes.

• Maintain the enterprise data classification framework and associated handling and protection requirements.

• Map regulatory and contractual obligations to data classes and ensure appropriate controls are enforced.

• Define secure data storage requirements and validate compliance with encryption, access, and monitoring standards.

• Monitor storage environments to prevent unauthorized access, loss, or misuse.

• Govern role based access, periodic reviews, and monitoring of data usage and behavior.

• Partner with cross functional teams to detect and respond to inappropriate access.

• Establish secure data sharing and transmission standards and govern internal/external disclosures.

• Maintain approval workflows, logging, and traceability for data transfers.

• Assess data sharing risks in partnership with Third Party Risk Management.

• Develop and maintain data retention schedules aligned with legal, regulatory, and business needs.

• Govern archival processes and access restrictions for inactive data.

• Define secure data destruction standards, validate retention obligations, and maintain destruction evidence.

• Oversee third party destruction activities for compliance.

• Develop KPIs, KRIs, maturity metrics, dashboards, and executive reporting.

• Identify program gaps, drive remediation, and support audits and regulatory examinations.

• Serve as the enterprise SME for data governance, providing training and awareness.

• Build relationships with IT, Security, Privacy, Legal, Risk, and business units to promote adoption.

• Support AI governance and trusted data initiatives.


Required Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Information Management, Information Security, Data Governance, or related field (Master’s preferred).

• Experience in data governance, data management, GRC, or related discipline.

• Proven experience building or significantly maturing a data governance program.

• Strong knowledge of data lifecycle management practices.

• Experience implementing data classification and retention frameworks.

• Familiarity with regulations impacting data (e.g., SOX, privacy laws, industry standards).

• Experience working in fast-paced, transformation-focused environments.

• Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.

• Excellent executive-level communication and stakeholder management skills.

• Ability to drive initiatives independently with minimal oversight.

Our Client is a dynamic company focused on leveraging digital platforms to drive brand engagement and growth. They specialize in creating innovative social media strategies to enhance visibility and interaction across various channels.

Our client is seeking a Social Media Growth Strategist to lead and execute high-performance growth initiatives for their Instagram presence. title: Analista de Martech Sênior – Tagueamento & Tracking
description:
Você tem experiência sólida em coleta de dados e quer atuar num ambiente onde o trabalho técnico tem impacto direto em produto, mídia e CRM? Essa vaga é para você. Aqui você será a referência técnica do time de Tagueamento: a pessoa que define padrões, garante a qualidade da coleta e conecta necessidades de negócio com soluções de dados confiáveis. O dia a dia é híbrido, com parte do tempo acompanhando produtos em desenvolvimento e parte apoiando o hub técnico com especificações e validações.
O Que Você Vai Fazer
  • Desenhar e liderar planos de tagueamento end-to-end para web e app, incluindo mapas de coleta e estruturação de data layer.
  • Ser o responsável técnico pelo GTM e GA4: governança de containers, padrões de nomenclatura, auditorias e evolução das implementações.
  • Estruturar e revisar implementações de eventos mobile no AppsFlyer e Firebase, incluindo deep links, in-app events e atribuição de campanhas.
  • Implementar pixels de mídia e integrações via API de Conversões.
  • Apoiar os times de mídia paga e CRM com dados consistentes, identificando gaps de coleta e propondo soluções de forma proativa.
  • Escrever e revisar queries SQL no BigQuery para validação de coleta, análise de qualidade de dados e suporte a dashboards no Looker Studio.
  • Especificar e acompanhar a instrumentação de testes A/B no Optimizely e Firebase A/B Testing, com atenção à amostragem, contaminação de variantes e integridade dos resultados.
  • Documentar decisões técnicas, criar padrões e contribuir com o desenvolvimento de perfis júnior e pleno do time.
O Que Buscamos
  • Experiência avançada com GTM, incluindo arquitetura server-side.
  • Conhecimento sólido de JavaScript e familiaridade com React para entender como aplicações SPA afetam o comportamento do tracking e orientar implementações corretamente.
  • Experiência com AppsFlyer e/ou Firebase em atribuição, eventos customizados, deep links e SKAdNetwork.
  • GA4 com profundidade em governança de propriedades, modelagem de eventos, exploração de dados e integração com BigQuery.
  • SQL intermediário-avançado no BigQuery ou similar, com CTEs, window functions e joins complexos para validação de coleta e suporte analítico.
  • Visão de arquitetura de coleta end-to-end, da definição do evento até o dado disponível para consumo.
  • Capacidade de traduzir necessidades de negócio em planos de tagueamento claros e de comunicar decisões técnicas tanto para engenheiros quanto para stakeholders não técnicos.
Diferenciais
  • Familiaridade com desenvolvimento mobile nativo em Kotlin e/ou Swift para especificar e validar implementações junto aos times de desenvolvimento.
  • Conhecimento de LGPD, Consent Mode e cookieless tracking e seus impactos na qualidade dos dados de mídia.
  • Experiência com observabilidade de dados com Monte Carlo, dbt tests ou validações customizadas.
  • Passagem por times de produto ou agências com múltiplos clientes e verticais.
Como avaliamos
O processo inclui um exercício técnico com um cenário real: desenho de mapa de coleta, estrutura de data layer e validação de coleta em web ou app. Depois, uma conversa sobre decisões que você tomou, problemas que resolveu e como você lida com situações de ambiguidade.

title: Founding QA / Test Automation Engineer (Full Stack, AI + Data Systems)
description:
Job Description

We’re a stealth startup backed by a repeat founder and top-tier investors.


We’re rebuilding the financial plumbing behind a trillion-dollar asset class — commercial real estate insurance — one of the largest, most archaic financial systems in the United States.


Today, this market still runs on manual workflows, fragmented data, and decades-old infrastructure.

Our top competitors represent over $300B in combined market value, and the core workflows in this industry have not been meaningfully disrupted in decades.


We’re building an AI-native platform that ingests fragmented insurance data across documents, APIs, and third-party systems, and transforms it into a unified, structured layer for underwriting and decision-making.


Incubated by a team that has already built two successful companies in this exact industry and ICP, we’re now assembling a world-class team to build the next one.


We are assembling the Avengers of financial services and insurance tech — a small, elite team of builders who want to define this category.


We’re looking for a Founding QA / Test Automation Engineer to ensure every data point we produce is correct, reliable, and production-ready.


This is not traditional QA. This is owning quality across AI systems, data pipelines, and critical financial infrastructure — where silent failures are unacceptable.


The Role

As the Founding QA / Test Automation Engineer, you will:

- Own testing across the full stack — frontend, backend, and AI/ML outputs

- Build testing infrastructure and CI/CD pipelines from scratch

- Design regression frameworks to detect accuracy drift across model and prompt changes

- Validate complex data pipelines where correctness is non-negotiable

- Define and enforce quality standards across deterministic systems and AI/ML outputs

- Work directly with founders and engineers to ship quickly without compromising quality

- Set the bar for all future QA and engineering hires


What You’ll Own

- End-to-end validation of data and document processing systems from ingestion through structured output

- Regression frameworks to ensure accuracy and consistency across evolving AI/ML systems

- API integration testing and validation of external data flows

- Frontend critical user flows across core product experiences

- CI/CD pipelines and automated quality gates across the stack

- Monitoring and alerting for production systems to ensure reliability at scale


Who Are You?

- You’ve tested systems where correctness actually matters (financial data, insurance, data infrastructure, or document processing)

- Experience at high-growth startups where speed and quality both matter

- You understand how to validate data pipelines and AI/ML outputs — not just web apps

- You’ve built or want to build automated testing frameworks from scratch

- Comfortable operating across backend systems, APIs, and frontend applications

- Highly technical, AI-native, and systems-oriented

- Relentless attention to detail — you catch what others miss


Technical Skills

- Python (pytest or similar)

- Playwright or Cypress

- CI/CD (GitHub Actions or similar)

- Experience testing APIs, data pipelines, and distributed systems


Bonus:

- Experience testing LLM or AI systems

- Experience building regression or evaluation frameworks

- Experience with document processing or OCR systems

- Experience working in insurance or insurtech environments


Culture & Expectations

This is an intense, output-driven environment.

We operate at high velocity with a small team of exceptional builders.

We operate on a 9-9-6 cadence — because rebuilding an industry demands it.

High ownership. High accountability. High standards.

We don’t care about pedigree, background, or years of experience. We care about ability.

We are looking for the top 0.0001% — people who take pride in building systems that must work.


Logistics

- Quarterly trips to NYC for collaboration


Compensation

Competitive salary

Meaningful equity

Leadership path fully uncapped for the right person


Who This Is Ideal For

A QA / Test Automation engineer who has operated as a founding or early QA hire (#1/#2) at a high-growth startup, or someone who has built and scaled testing infrastructure in fast-moving environments. You should genuinely believe you are the strongest QA engineers in any room and want the opportunity to own quality end-to-end — from building the testing foundation to shaping how an entire engineering organization thinks about correctness and reliability.


Why Join Now?

You’d be joining at the exact moment when:

- The company is fully incubated and de-risked by proven founders

- Two successful companies have already been built in this domain

- The wedge is validated, pipeline active, customers already aligned

- The market is at a breaking point and demanding change

- The next 18 months will define a multi-billion-dollar outcome


If you’re hungry, relentless, and want to help rearchitect a trillion-dollar market — reach out. There aren’t many chances to be this early on something this big.

title: Analista de Negócios Pleno
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.


A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.


Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.


E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.


Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.



Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Elaborar apresentações comerciais;
  • Analisar materiais e subsídios para a realização de comitês internos e do empreendedor, avaliando critérios como mix de produtos, metragem, valor por metro quadrado, entre outros;
  • Validar o faturamento referente às despesas locatícias das entidades por meio de sistemas internos, conferindo reajustes, valores e demais informações pertinentes;
  • Atuar como ponto de contato e manter interface direta com lojistas.

description:
Sobre a BALQ  

A BALQ é uma plataforma SaaS focada na indústria plástica que coleta, organiza, armazena e trata dados do processo para monitorar a produção, gerar inteligência e promover o uso de KPIs que orientam a tomada de decisão em busca de melhor performance.

Você será responsável por atuar diretamente no chão de fábrica (in loco), garantindo que o nosso MES seja implementado com sucesso e que a operação do cliente extraia o máximo de valor da ferramenta. Suas responsabilidades englobam: 


  • Suporte In Loco:  Atuar de forma presencial na unidade do cliente, diagnosticando e resolvendo problemas na captura de dados, uso do MES e conectividade;

  • Acompanhamento de Turnos:  Monitorar a performance do sistema em diferentes cenários de produção, adaptando seu horário de trabalho para acompanhar turnos específicos quando necessário; 
  • Treinamento de Operadores:  Capacitar as equipes de chão de fábrica para a correta utilização dos hardwares e da interface do sistema;

Necessário ter:  

  • Formação superior (completa ou cursando) em Engenharia, Tecnólogo em Automação, Mecatrônica, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas; 
  • Residência em Abreu e Lima/Recife - PE (ou disponibilidade imediata para atuar na região);

Diferenciais:

  • Afinidade e curiosidade técnica para lidar com hardwares; 
  • Vivência prévia na indústria de transformação plástica; 
  • Familiaridade com sistemas MES ou conceitos de Indústria 4.0. 

Soft-skills esperados:  

  • Proatividade e perfil \"mão na massa\" para resolver problemas reais na linha de produção e investigar gargalos físicos ou de software; 
  • Excelente comunicação interpessoal para transitar bem tanto com operadores de máquina quanto com a gerência da fábrica;

You will assess how well the model uses information from your past Gemini conversations, Gmail, Google Search, and YouTube activity to make responses more relevant and helpful. This role requires a unique blend of creativity and analytical rigor. You will actively design prompts from the perspective of your own personal experiences. You will then use your analytical skills to assess the quality of the model's personalized responses, evaluating dimensions like Grounding, Integration, and Helpfulness.


Key Qualifications:

  • Japanese Proficiency: Ability to read and write in Japanese with a high degree of comp, as Japanese is the focus language for this project.
  • Personal Account Usage: Willingness to use your primary personal Google account (not a testing account) and enable personal data sources for a genuine assessment.
  • Schedule Flexibility: Full-time availability in your local time zone is required. We are staffing a global, 24-hour operations team.
  • Exceptional Analytical Thinking: Demonstrate ability to evaluate nuanced and ambiguous AI responses, specifically assessing personalization quality.
  • Creative Prompt Engineering: Experience in designing creative, multi-turn starting prompts based on personal context to thoroughly test the model's capabilities.
  • Strong Evaluation Acumen: Understanding of personalization concepts, including the ability to identify incorrect personalization, poor inferences, and forced connections.
  • Meticulous Attention to Detail: The ability to review Side-by-Side (SxS) model responses and spot subtle differences in naturalness and overnarrating.
  • Excellent Written Communication: Superior ability to write clear, concise, and structured rationales for model rankings, explicitly referencing specific turn numbers.
  • Feedback: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Technical Setup: Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Description:

  • In this role, you will be part of a dynamic team focused on evaluating the quality of personalized AI interactions.

Your day-to-day work will involve:

  • Designing and executing multi-turn conversational prompts (typically 1-5 turns) that require the AI to utilize your personal information and experiences.
  • Evaluating model responses based on your intent from the starting prompt, checking if the personalization was appropriately applied.
  • Analyzing responses for Grounding issues, ensuring claims about you are supported by evidence and not flawed inferences or hallucinations.
  • Assessing Integration quality to ensure personal data is woven naturally into the response without robotic \"overnarrating\".
  • Rigorously evaluating and stack-ranking two model responses side-by-side (SxS) to determine which is overall more helpful, easy to use, and enjoyable.
  • Writing clear, defensible rationales for your comparisons, explicitly referencing where issues or positive aspects occurred in the conversation.
  • Extracting and verifying \"Debug Info\" from the model to confirm that chat summaries and data sources were properly utilized.
  • Maintaining strict data hygiene by deleting evaluation conversations to prevent them from polluting your future chat history.


Education & Experience:

  • BS/BA degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field (e.g., Policy, Law, Ethics, Linguistics, Journalism, Computer Science, or a related analytical field).
  • Experience in data annotation, AI quality evaluation, content moderation, or a related role is strongly preferred.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and minimum 30 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST. (We have 2 options of time commitment: 30 hrs/week or 40 hrs/week)
  • Engagement type: Contractor
  • Engagement Length: 3 months
